title: A named profile alias expands to the four-field workflowShape before any consumer reads it
asA: operator standing up a small library project on delivery-ci-workflows v2
iWant: to declare my workflow shape as a named profile alias (`smallLibrary`, `smallService`, `internalPackage`, `trunkLibrary`) rather than filling four fields explicitly
soThat: the common cases stay short while every downstream still sees one authoritative representation

acceptanceCriteria.description: A `workflowShape` declared as `{ "alias": "smallLibrary" }` is expanded at boot to the four-field form (`branchModel: feature`, `checkSet: <all-true>`, `releaseMode: tagPlusArtefact`, `providerHint: githubActions`). Every downstream in this blueprint binds to the four-field form. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets the workflowShape elicits (checkSet, branchModel, releaseMode, scheduledAudit, providerHint); the AC substitutes the project's declaration for the illustrative shape values.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a `workflowShape` declaration carrying only the alias field with value `smallLibrary`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the materialiser expands the alias to the four-field composition, records the expansion in its own log, and treats the four-field form as authoritative for materialisation

acceptanceCriteria.description: An alias name that the shipped set does not include causes a boot-check failure with a stable-coded error naming the alias and listing the shipped set. A project that wants a shape the aliases do not cover uses the four-field form directly. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets the workflowShape elicits (checkSet, branchModel, releaseMode, scheduledAudit, providerHint); the AC substitutes the project's declaration for the illustrative shape values.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the materialiser exits non-zero with a stable-coded error naming the alias, the shipped-set list, and the four-field form as the fallback

acceptanceCriteria.description: A workflowShape configuration that combines a named profile alias with an inline override for the same field fails at expansion time with WORKFLOW_SHAPE_CONFLICT naming the field and the two sources; the materialiser refuses ambiguity. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets the elicited workflowShape (the profile alias name and any inline field override); the AC substitutes the project's alias and inline pair for the illustrative trunk-lite profile paired with branchModel=feature.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a workflowShape configuration with profile=trunk-lite AND branchModel=feature (the alias sets trunk, the inline sets feature)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the expander refuses with WORKFLOW_SHAPE_CONFLICT naming branchModel and the two sources
